The gondola's lack of detail is correctly flagged. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask suggests the overall shape is coherent, but it doesn't rule out the internal 'melted' look of the gondola noted by the Router. I will maintain the severity ratings but emphasize the text error as the primary defect.
